description: Defines utilities and functions related to spectral operations, including Fourier transform conjugate symmetry, size inference for real-to-complex FFTs, and dispatch mechanisms in the ATen library.

methods.name: infer_ft_real_to_complex_onesided_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the one-sided spectrum from the real signal size in FFT.

methods.name: infer_ft_complex_to_real_onesided_size
methods.description: Infers the real signal size from the one-sided complex frequency size, with optional expected size.

methods.name: _fft_fill_with_conjugate_symmetry_
methods.description: Fills the missing half of the FFT output using Hermitian symmetry.
